Additional work includes creating effective products using an attribute solver and unified presentation of cross-platform content to users. These areas collectively address optimization of search, promotions, and ads in marketplace environments.

about_short_description.short_description: Promoted unifies organic search, promotions, and ads in one optimized system for marketplaces.

product.name: Unified Ranking System
product.description: A system that optimizes search, ads, and recommendations in marketplaces to improve long-term business outcomes like sales and revenue.

product.name: Client and Server Metrics SDKs
product.description: Software development kits that collect user interaction data and marketplace events to support real-time optimization and reporting.

product.name: Delivery API
product.description: An API that re-ranks marketplace listings in real-time for search, feed, and paid promotions based on machine learning models.

product.name: Blender Allocation Rules
product.description: A system that manages optimization functions, diversity controls, and placement rules for search and ads without disrupting ongoing optimization.

product.name: Introspection Tool
product.description: A tool that provides transparency into why specific listings, ads, or promotions appear in certain positions within search and feed results.

product.name: Discount Promotions Optimization
product.description: A service that optimizes discount promotions, merchandising, and offers within marketplaces to support growth.
